title: Accounts Receivable Rule: Price Share on Gas Catch-Up Therms by Payment Standing
content:
# Catch-Up Price Share by Payment Standing — Utility Services Program

**Rule.** The counted gas catch-up therms on a Utility Services Program gas true-up line are priced at a catch-up price share of the gas rate per therm, set by the resident's payment standing:

| Payment standing | Catch-up price share |
|---|---|
| the Apartment Home Lease is enrolled in rent autopay **and** at least 6 utility payments were received fewer than six whole months before the billing date | 80% of the gas rate (0.80) |
| at least 6 utility payments were received in that time **and** the lease is not enrolled in autopay | 90% of the gas rate (0.90) |
| every other situation | the full rate (1.0) |

Utility payments are the payments received on the utility account; the six-month window is measured back from the billing date. Autopay enrollment is read from the Apartment Home Lease.

## Combinations

| Enrolled in rent autopay | Utility payments in the six months | Share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 6 or more | 0.80 |
| yes | 5 or fewer | 1.0 |
| no | 6 or more | 0.90 |
| no | 5 or fewer | 1.0 |

## Effect on the line (hypothetical figures)

The price share applies to the counted catch-up therms only; the true-up period's own gas usage is priced at the full rate. The priced usage is the own gas usage plus the counted catch-up times the share, rounded to 3 decimals, and it is then priced at the gas rate. With an own gas usage of 34.000 therms and a counted catch-up of 13 therms:

- share 0.80: 34.000 plus 10.400 is 44.400 therms priced;
- share 0.90: 34.000 plus 11.700 is 45.700 therms priced;
- share 1.0: 47.000 therms priced.
